product_metadata.title: Wine Enthusiast Legacy Corkscrew with Birch Stand, Antique Bronze
features: Regal replica of an antique corkscrew promise years of effort-free openings
Inner workings and grapevine-relief casing made of lasting zinc alloy
description: Our bestseller-now better than ever. Enhancements to our regal replica of an antique corkscrew promise years of effort-free openings. A smooth-gliding, Teflon-coated worm removes corks (natural and synthetic) with a simple pull of the handle. Inner workings and grapevine-relief casing made of lasting zinc alloy. Antique bronze finish. Can also mount to your bar. Includes 19-1/2"H Birch stand with stationary corkscrew. Size: Corkscrew - 8-1/2"H; Stand - 19-1/2"H This corkscrew is synthetic cork friendly.
